options.euphoriapacing.targetFps.tooltip: The framerate Euphoria Pacing tries to maintain. When FPS drops below this, Euphoria Pacing dynamically scales down non-essential visuals and restores them once performance stabilizes.
options.euphoriapacing.autoQuality.toolt: Automatically adapts entity distance, particles, clouds, and simulation load to maintain smooth, consistent frame times.
options.euphoriapacing.blockEntityCullin: Adaptively culls distant tile entities (chests, signs, banners) in large storage rooms and bases, significantly improving framerate.
options.euphoriapacing.budgetedUploads.t: Smoothly budgets chunk mesh GPU uploads across frames with dynamic elasticity to eliminate micro-stutters during terrain generation.
